Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! Bangladesh players are out there in the middle. Kyle Verreynne and Janneman Malan are the openers for South Africa. Shakib Al Hasan to start with the ball for Bangladesh. Here we go...
...THE RUN CHASE…
Now the target is a big one. South Africa need to bat really well if they are to chase this down. Bangladesh have variety in their bowling and will back themselves to defend it. Chase in a bit…

Yasir Ali is down for a quick chat. He says that he is very happy with the innings. He mentions that Tamim and Das did the hard job early on and the pitch became better later on and they just backed themselves. He mentions that he was prepared for the short ball and says that he liked his straight shot against Ngidi the most. He says they are confident of defending this total but adds that they need to bowl well.

The bowling was good to begin with but post the 35th over, it all went wrong for South Africa. Their bowlers were taken to the cleaners. Lungi Ngidi had a day to forget. The others too were on the expensive side. Maharaj though bowled decently and so did Jansen but overall it was not a good performance.

It was the openers who led the way for the visitors as they added 95. They went about things slowly but it wasn’t easy to bat against the new ball. Then, there was a time where they lost 3 in quick succession but then came the stand which turned the game in the visitors’ favor. Yasir Ali and Shakib Al Hasan added more than 100 with both scoring half tons. Both though fell in quick succession but a few handy innings down the order has taken them to a score which is just above par.

End of an excellent batting performance from the visitors and they will be extremely pleased with where they stand in the game at the moment. South Africa on the other hand, look a little deflated as they walk off as they know they have a big task ahead of them.
Dot to end the innings! Ngidi finally nails a yorker. It is outside off. Hasan looks to get a bat on it but misses. Bangladesh finish with 314/7 after their alloted 50 overs!
SIX! Now he connects and a big one! A slower length ball, oaround off. In the slot and Hasan heaves it towards deep square leg for a biggie.

Now they steal a bye! A length delivery, outside off. Slower in pace. Ahmed goes for a big heave across the line but misses. The ball goes off the bounce to the keeper and batters take a bye is the meanwhile.
Goes slightly shorter on middle. Hasan pulls it to deep square leg for a single.

Two runs now! In the air..but safe!  A length delivery on off. Hasan goes for a big heave across the line but miscues it. The ball goes in the air and falls short of the long on fielder. Couple of runs taken.
Dot to start the final over! A fullish delivery, outside off. Mehidy Hasan dances down the track and looks to go big towards the leg side but misses.
Lands this on a length again, around off. Hasan dabs it to point and takes a quick single.
SIX! 300 up in style! A length delivery on off. At a comfortable height for Hasan to go for a big one. He heaves it over deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
A length delivery, on off. Taskin Ahmed goes for a big heave across the line but gets this to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Boundary now, they are inching close to 300! Slightly shorter on middle. Ahmed pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary.
WIDE! This is full and way outside off. Ahmed throws his bat at it but misses.

Single off an overthrow! A slower length delivery, around off. Hasan pushes it towards point and they think of a single initially but decides against it. There is a shy at the batter's end but missed. A run taken in the end off an overthrow.
A length delivery, around off. Ahmed pushes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Goes fuller on middle. Ahmed drives it to long on for a single.
Taskin Ahmed is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mahmudullah departs now and Marco Jansen gets his second wicket! A slower length ball, outside off. Mahmudullah makes room and looks to go inside out. However, he is deceived by the slower pace of the ball and slices it towards point. Rassie van der Dussen there takes a good catch moving to his back and this wicket can make a difference of 20 runs in the end.
Commentary.Howout: c Rassie van der Dussen b Marco Jansen

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Good shot! This one is short on middle. Mahmudullah pulls it over deep backward square leg for a maximum.
Direct hit and it would have been close! A length delivery, around off. Hasan dabs it towards backward point and takes a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the batter's end but misses.
Bangs this one short angling into the body. Mahmudullah pulls but is hurried by this short ball and the ball goes in the air towards mid-wicket for a single.
This one is shorter on middle. Mahmudullah pulls it towards backward square leg. The fielder there runs to his right and dives to save two runs for his team. Two taken.
Goes fuller outside off. Mahmudullah drives it to deep cover for a single.
Goes slightly shorter around off. Hasan steers it towards third man for a single.
Slower delivery again, outside off. Hasan looks to drive but misses.
A slower length delivery, outside off. Hasan looks to cut but misses.
WIDE! Another wide. This is fuller and way too wide outside off. Hasan lets it go.
WIDE! Shorter length again and a tad too wide outside off. Hasan lets it go.
Short and outside off. Hasan looks to cut but misses.
WIDE! Slower delivery and way too wide outside off. Hasan leaves it alone.
A fuller delivery on off. Mahmudullah drills it to long off for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! Afif Hossain gets across and he was trying to play that shot couple of times before but it leads to him losing his wicket. A fuller delivery, outside off. Afif Hossain gets across and looks to find the gap towards the leg side as the fielders are in the ring behind square. The ball goes straight to backward square leg and Rassie van der Dussen takes a good catch. Mehidy Hasan is the next man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Rassie van der Dussen b Marco Jansen

Commentary.Commentary: A slower length ball from 'round the wicket angling into middle and leg. Mahmudullah looks to work it towards the leg side but gets the inside edge onto his pads for a single.
A length delivery, outside off. Afif Hossain drills it to long off for a single.
Goes shorter on middle at 136 kph from 'round the wicket. Mahmudullah pulls it to fine leg for a single.
A length delivery, on off. Afif Hossain pushes it to covers for a single.
WIDE! Goes fuller and way too wide outside off. Afif Hossain gets across and looks to reverse-scoop it but misses.
Back of a length, on middle from 'round the wicket. Mahmudullah works this with the angle towards fine leg for a single.
Marco Jansen is back on. He has bowled 8 overs so far and has given away 40 runs.
Pitches this on a length, on middle. Mahmudullah works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
A slower length delivery around off. Afif Hossain goes for a reverse-sweep but the ball hits his glove and a single is taken towards the off side.
Lands this on a length and keeps it away from the batter again. Mahmudullah slashes this hard and the ball goes towards sweeper cover for a single.
A slower length delivery, outside off. Afif Hossain drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Again serves this outside off. On a length this time. Mahmudullah drives it to deep cover for a single.
A slower full delivery, outside off at 103 kph. Mahmudullah drives it to deep extra-cover for a couple.
WIDE! Andile Phehlukwayo starts the new spell with a wide! He tries a slower delivery but it is way too wide outside off. Mahmudullah leaves it alone.
Back of a length, outside off. Mahmudullah dabs it to backward point for a single. 12 runs from the over!
This time a single. On a length, on off. Afif Hossain pushes it to covers for a single.
Another slower delivery at 117 kph. Lands this on a length and outside off. Afif Hossain gets beaten again as he tries to push it towards the off side.
Good comeback frm Ngidi! A slower length ball, outside off. Afif Hossain tries to push it but gets beaten by the lack of pace.
SIX! This time a biggie! A length delivery on middle, in the slot. Afif Hossain heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
FOUR! Boundaries are still flowing for Bangladesh! Drifts on the pads, Afif Hossain just flicks it towards deep backward square leg for a boundary. 250 up for Bangladesh!
Good-length delivery, around off at 136 kph. Mahmudullah dabs it towards point.
Bangs this one short around leg. Afif Hossain pulls it to fine leg for a single.

Back of a length, on middle. Afif Hossain looks to work it towards the leg side but gets a glove onto the turf. He has hurt his fingers there and is getting some treatment now as physio comes out. Good to resume now.
A good-length delivery around off. Mahmudullah steers it towards third man for a single.
A length delivery on off. Afif Hossain pushes it towards the off side for a single.
Afif Hossain is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! So both the set batters are gone now! Kagiso Rabada strikes and Yasir Ali walks back after a very good knock. A short delivery and a pacy one on middle. Ali goes for the pull shot but is early on the shot and gets the cue end of his blade. The ball goes back to Rabada, he takes a fine catch and South Africa are back in it.
FOUR! Mahmudullah starts off with a boundary! Excellent shot first up! Overpitched outside off. Mahmudullah creams a cover-drive for a boundary.
Mahmudullah walks in at number 6.

OUT! LBW! That is plumb in front and the stand which was taking the game away from South Africa has been broken. End of a brilliant innings from Shakib. Just brilliant. A very good delivery to get rid of him. A yorker on middle, Shakib Al Hasan looks to paddle scoop it but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal and the finger is raised. Can now South Africa pull things back?
Fifty for Ali! His first in ODIs! A superb innings from him. Very strong shots but he needs to make it big now, has the chance. On the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
A yorker, full and outside off, this is jammed out through covers for one.
A slower one this time outside off, Shakib swings but misses.
FOUR! EDGY! Nothing going South Africa's way at the moment! Fuller and wide outside off, Shakib swings, it goes off the outside edge and past the short third man fielder and into the fence.
SIX! No, he can't! A short-arm jab by Yasir Ali and the last ball spoils the over. On middle, Yasir whips it uppishly and wide of the man at deep mid-wicket. It flies all the way.
Just the one! A slower bumper, Shakib looks to pull, it goes off the top edge towards fine leg for one. Can Rabada end the over well now?
That is sharp! A bumper and on middle, Shakib looks to pull but is beaten for pace.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Good stuff! A yorker again and on off, this is jammed out towards cover for one.
The 100-run stand is up! An outstanding partnership! Can they help Bangladesh to get over 300 now? Very full and on middle, this is worked towards short fine leg for one.
FOUR! Another slot ball and Shakib and Yasir are taking the game away. 15 from the over. Fuller and on middle, this is thumped over the bowler's head for a boundary.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
SIX! BANG! That has gone over the fence and 300 is surely on here! On middle, fuller, this is heaved over the long on fence for a biggie.
That is brilliant from Markram! Shorter and outside off, this is guided to the left of Markram, he dives and makes a stop. They take a single though.
FOUR! Powered again! That has gone so quickly to the fence! Shorter and on middle, Ali pulls it very hard and flat, wide of deep square leg for a boundary. The hosts under pressure here.
Good length and on off, this is pushed to cover.

Ohh..just away from Kyle Verreynne who dives to his left! A short delivery on off. Shakib Al Hasan looks to pull but gets an edge off his blade. Kyle Verreynne who first moves to his right has to dive to his left. He fails to grab it and couple of runs are taken towards third man.
Pitches this one up, on middle. Ali works it to deep square leg for a single.
Goes short this time on off. Shakib Al Hasan gets across and pulls it to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Ohh..brilliant batting from Shakib Al Hasan! On a length, around leg. Shakib Al Hasan gets across and scoops it towards long leg for a boundary.
Short and wide outside off. Shakib Al Hasan cuts it hard but straight to backward point.
Back of a length, around off. Ali steers it towards third man for a single. 200 up for Bangladesh!
SIX! That has gone all the way and the last ball spoils the over! Fuller and on middle, this is lofted over the long off fence for a biggie.
Two is the call but it is only one! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and on off, this is guided to point. Need ot bowl more dots, that will build pressure.
A single now! Angled into the pads, this is nudged around the corner for one.
On off, this is driven through covers for one.
Shakib makes room and Andile Phehlukwayo follows him with a slower one, it is worked through square leg for one.
FOUR! Put away! Second boundary in the over and Bangladesh are racing along nicely here! Short and on middle, this is pulled again through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Two more! On middle, Yasir works it through mid-wicket, wide of the fielder in the deep for two.
Length and around off, this is guided to point.
Shorter and on the body, Shakib looks to pull, it hits the glove and goes on the leg side for one.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
FOUR! Powered! Fuller and on middle, Ali smashes it back past the bowler and this one races away down to the long off fence. It also hits the stumps at the other end but no stopping that.
Goes full on middle. Ali drives it to long on for a single. Good over by Andile Phehlukwayo.
A length ball, on off. Ali blocks this towards mid on.
Fullish delivery on middle. Ali drives it to mid on.
Lands this on a length, on middle. Ali works it towards the leg side.

NOT OUT! A single in the end! That would have been a disaster had that been a run out. Around off, this is guided towards short third man. Shakib wants a run but is sent back. Rabada has a needless shy at the keeper's end and hits the stumps, The ball rolls towards the bowler who has his back towards the ball and walking back to his run-up. Shakib sees that and goes for a run. Andile Phehlukwayo realizes, turns, picks it up and hits the stumps at his end. An appeal and it is taken upstairs. Time for the replays and they show that Shakib's dive has saved him.
Fuller and on off, Shakib hits it hard but to mid off.

SIX! BANG! That is hammered! Short and on middle, Ali hangs back and nails the pull. It sails over the square leg fence for a biggie. Powerful hit and these two are into top gear now. 50-run stand up, the two need to keep going.
Almost drags it on! Outside off, the cutter, grips in the surface a touch. Ali looks to guide it down to third man but gets an inside edge which almost hits the off pole.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Yasir looks to pull but misses.
Again, follows the boundary with one as this is worked through mid-wicket.
FOUR! Top edge and over the keeper! Shorter and on off, Shakib looks to drag the pull, it goes over the keeper and into the fence.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is clipped through square leg for one.
Good length and on off, Yasir looks to guide it on the off side but gets an underedge on the off side.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one. Good sensible batting.
SIX! That is over the fence! The two have probably decided to go after Andile Phehlukwayo! Fuller and right in the slot. On middle, this is lofted over the long on fence for a biggie.
Hammered again but only one! Shorter and outside off, this is hit again through covers, only for one.
FOUR! That is put away! Nicely hit! Shorter and outside off, Ali slaps it through covers for a boundary. Welcome one.
On middle, defended.

Wrong end! Had that been a throw to the correct end, Yasir Ali was a goner. On middle, shorter in length. Shakib comes down and looks to pull, it goes off the inside edge towards fine leg. The fielder there dives to his left and stops it. Ali wants a run and is halfway down the wicket but is sent back. The fielder fires it to the keeper.
Ali steps out and makes room, he looks to go over covers but it goes off the inner half through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, Shakib works it through mid-wicket for one.
A single as this is pushed through covers.
Gives it nice air and lands it on off, Ali blocks.
Floats it p on middle, defended.
FOUR! Pulled away! This one races away! Shorter and on the body, Shakib pulls it fine and this one races away to the fence.
Fuller and on middle, Ali works it towards mid-wicket for one.
On the pads, Ali looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Angled into the pads, Shakib works it towards mid-wicket for one.
On off, Shakib pushes it to covers.
A big appeal from the bowler but turned down! This is short and down the leg side. Shakib looks to pull but misses.

Drinks! This has been a good little phase for South Africa. They have managed to break the opening partnership and have now got three wickets to put the pressure on Bangladesh. Keshav Maharaj has taken two wickets and South Africa would hope for more wickets to restrict Bangladesh to a modest total. Shakib Al Hasan is still in the crease for Bangladesh and they need a partnership now to post a challenging total on the board.
Another single to end! Angled into the pads, Shakib works it through square leg.
On off, Ali pushes it through covers for one.
On the bounce! Shorter and on middle, Shakib pulls, it goes in the air but short of deep square leg. One taken.
Slows it up and lands it fuller and on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Flatter and on middle, defended.
On middle, Shakib comes down and works it through square leg for one.
Goes shorter on off. Yasir Ali looks to defend but is surprised by the bounce and ends up defending it onto the pitch off his glove.
Back of a length, around off. Ali dabs it towards point.
Slightly shorter around off. Shakib Al Hasan opens the face of his blade and guides it towards third man for a single.
On a length, on middle. Ali pushes it to mid on and takes a single.
Back of a length, around off. Ali sways away from the line of the ball and lets it go.
Bangs this one short on off. Ali goes for the pull shot. He gets a top edge and the ball goes high in the air. It falls in the vacant region at backward square leg and the batters run couple.
NO BALL! Ohh...a beamer from Jansen! That is called no ball and a Free Hit comimg up. On middle. Shakib Al Hasan pulls it to fine leg for a single.
Nicely tossed up around off. Ali gets well forward and blocks it.
Goes flatter on middle. Shakib Al Hasan skips down the track and works it towards backward square leg for a single.
A flatter delivery on off. Shakib Al Hasan works it towards mid-wicket.
There seems to be some problem with Shakib Al Hasan's left leg. The physio is out and he is getting some treatment now. He looks fine after some work on his leg and is all set to resume.

FOUR! Shakib Al Hasan continues to remain positive. This is tossed up on off. Shakib Al Hasan skips down the track and slams it down the ground for a boundary as he beats the long on fielder running to his right.
Yasir Ali is the next batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Keshav Maharaj gets his second wicket and Rahim departs playing his favourite shot, slog-sweep! This is darted on middle. Rahim goes for the slog-sweep shot but gets a huge top edge. The ball goes towards the backward square leg region and Miller at short fine leg moves to his left to take a fine catch. Big wicket this and third wicket down now.
Commentary.Howout: c David Miller b Keshav Maharaj

Commentary.Commentary: A shorter length delivery on middle. Shakib Al Hasan hits it firmly towards deep square leg for a single.
Now he goes quicker and serves a shorter delivery around off at 140 kph. Rahim sways away and looks to late cut it but misses.
Slower ball this time, on off at 123 kph. Rahim picks it and pushes it towards mid off.
On a length and angling across Rahim. He dabs it towards gully.
On a length and this one skids off the surface. Shakib Al Hasan dabs it towards backward point for a single.
Back of a length, on middle this time. Rahim works it towards backward square leg for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Rahim dabs it towards point.
Flatter and on middle and leg. Shakib Al Hasan works it towards mid-wicket.
Shakib Al Hasan skips down the track and the bowler pulls his length back, on off. Shakib Al Hasan pushes it towards the leg side.
Slower in the air, on middle. Shakib Al Hasan tries to work it towards the leg side but gets a leading edge towards the off side.
Darted on the pads. Rahim nudges it towards the leg side for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Rahim pushes this back to the bowler.

An appeal from Keshav Maharaj but no damage done! A flatter delivery around off. Shakib Al Hasan skips down the track and then tries to sweep it. He misses and the ball deflects towards the third man region. The batters run three leg bye as the appeal is turned down by the umpire.
Back of a length, on middle. Shakib Al Hasan works it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Goes fuller on middle. Rahim just tucks it to fine leg for a single.
Lands this on a length, on off. Shakib Al Hasan drives it to mid off without much timing for a single.
Angling into leg. Shakib Al Hasan works it fine towards long leg for a couple.
Way too wide outside off. Shakib Al Hasan still goes chasing for it and gets the bottom of his blade.
A length delivery, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan goes hard at it but gets the bottom edge and the ball falls just short of the keeper behind the stumps.
Full on middle. Shakib Al Hasan pushes it to long on for a single.

A half-appeal there but no damage done! A fuller delivery that is pitching on off and turning into middle. Shakib Al Hasan looks to work it towards the leg side but the ball hits his pads. Impact is outside off.
Slower in the air, around off. Rahim pushes it square off the wicket on the off side for a single.
FOUR! Put away! This is darted on middle and leg. Rahim sweeps it through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Fuller on middle. Shakib Al Hasan eases it down to long on for a single.
Slower in the air, on middle. Rahim works it to deep square leg for a single.
Maiden over and this is a good little phase for South Africa. Pitches this on a length, around off. Shakib Al Hasan pushes it to short cover.
Tight line again! Lands this on a length, around off. Shakib Al Hasan blocks it out.
Lands this slightly fuller on off. Shakib Al Hasan drives it to short cover.
Goes fuller on off. Shakib Al Hasan works it towards mid-wicket again.
On a length, on middle. Shakib Al Hasan works it towards mid-wicket.
On a length, around off. Shakib Al Hasan dabs it towards point.
Mushfiqur Rahim is the next batter in.

OUT! BOWLED! Another wiccket for South Africa and Das departs immediately after getting to his fifty! This is slightly short but not short enough to cut. On the stumps and flatter. Das makes room and looks to cut it but misses as it stays slightly low again. The ball shatters the stumps and a big wicket for South Africa. So two wickets in quick succession now.
Fifty for Liton Das! He has started this series where he left against Afghanistan! Slightly short around off. Das cuts it towards deep point for a couple.
Das makes room and Maharaj follows him. Das punches it to point.
Slower in the air, on off. Das pushes it back to the bowler.
Goes slightly short and flatter. Shakib Al Hasan works it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller on middle. Shakib Al Hasan works it towards mid-wicket.
On a length and around off. Shakib Al Hasan steers it towards third man for a single.
WIDE! This is down the leg side and on a length. Shakib Al Hasan looks to clip it but misses. 100 up for Bangladesh with this wide.
FOUR! Cracking shot to get off the mark! This is full, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan leans forward and drives it through covers for a boundary.
On a length, on off. Shakib Al Hasan blocks it out.
Shakib Al Hasan is the next man in.

OUT! LBW! Andile Phehlukwayo strikes and provides the first breakthrough for South Africa. This is pitched slightly shorter in length and it probably hits the crack as it stays low. Tamim Iqbal looks to pull it but misses and the ball hits his pads. Tamim Iqbal would have not been able to do anything more with it. There is an appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Tamim Iqbal takes the review. The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows no bat involved. The Ball Tracker rolls and it shows three reds and Tamim Iqbal has to take a long walk back to the pavilion.
Back of a length, on off. Iqbal blocks this off the back foot.
Andile Phehlukwayo goes slightly short outside off. Das cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller on off. Das drives it to long off for a single. Decent over from Keshav Maharaj.
Quicker and fuller on off. Iqbal uses his wrists and pushes it to long on for a single.
A flatter delivery on middle. Iqbal works it towards square leg.
Slower in the air, on middle. Das skips down the track and works it right of mid on for a single.
Slower in the air, on middle. Das drives it to wide mid on.
A flatter delivery on middle. Iqbal works it towards deep square leg for a single.
On a length, on middle. Iqbal works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Tamim Iqbal joins the act now! Back of a length angling into middle from 'round the wicket. Iqbal gets across and uses the angle to work it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Uses the feet this time. Dances down the track. This is a length delivery, outside off. Das cuts it to third man for a single.
Slightly shorter this time. Around off at 126 kph. Das chops it towards backward point.
Lands this on a length, on off. Das defends it towards the off side.
Fullish delivery on middle. Das drives it towards mid-wicket.
A fuller delivery on middle. Das works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. Retains the strike.
FOUR! Das is targeting the spinner here! This is pushed quicker on middle. Das sweeeps and sweeps it well towards deep square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Another boundary! On middle and fuller. Das gets low and lifts this towards the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
SIX! Lovely shot! Shows the class of the man! This is tossed up on middle and leg. Das makes room and shimmies down the track. He goes inside out left of long off for a maximum.
Quicker on middle. Das sweeps it to short fine leg.
Slower in the air, on middle. Iqbal pushes it left of the bowler. Keshav Maharaj dives but half-stops it and a single is taken.
Angled on the pads now. Iqbal clips it to deep square leg for a single.
WIDE! Angles this down the leg side from 'round the wicket. Iqbal looks to clip it but misses.
On the shorter side yet again, outside off. Das cuts it to deep cover for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Das looks to cut it but misses.
Shorter delivery on middle. Iqbal pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Iqbal gets couple off the Free Hit! A fuller delivery on middle. Iqbal hits this over mid on but does not get the desired timing and two runs are taken as the fielder cuts it off.
NO BALL! A length delivery, outside off. Iqbal skips down the track and hits it towards point. Andile Phehlukwayo has overstepped and a Free Hit coming up now.
A fullish delivery on middle. Iqbal drives it to mid on.
MISFIELD AND FOUR! Shorter and outside off, Das cuts, it goes towards point where the fielder lets it through and it races away to the fence. Welcome boundary.
Tamim now takes one as he eases it down to long on.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
On middle, a little bit of turn and a little bit of extra bounce. It is defended.
On middle, this is eased down to long on for one.
On middle, defended.

Drinks! A solid start for Bangladesh to this first ODI. It is the highest opening-stand for Bangladesh against South Africa in the rainbow nation. One might argue that it is slightly on the slower side but Bangla Tigers will take it especially against a quality bowling attack in alien conditions. South African bowlers have bowled well but have failed to get a breakthrough. They will be looking to make inroads in this middle phase as Bangladesh have plenty of quality batters to follow.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one. A decent over for Bangladesh.
On middle, this is played back to the bowler.
Short, way too short actually, goes well over the batter's head. Wided.
Goes for a yorker now, Iqbal gets his bat down in time and jams it out.
On off, Das eases it past cover and gets to the other end.
Now does well, takes one after the boundary as he pulls this short ball through square leg.

EDGY FOUR! Bangladesh won't mind how they come as long as they do. 50 up for the visitors and this is their best opening stand in South Africa againts South Africa. Tamim feels the urge of stepping up the ante, he comes down the track, Jansen bangs it short. Tamim swings, it goes off the top edge, over the keeper and down to the third man fence.
A single! Another tidy over comes to an end! On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On middle, Tamim works it to mid-wicket.
On the stumps, played back to the bowler.
On the stumps, kept out.
Deft! On middle, Tamim plays the paddle scoop, fine on the leg side for two.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Time for spin now. Keshav Maharaj is into the attack.

That is a superb take by the keeper! A brute of a delivery too. Sees Das step out and bangs it short. This one keeps getting big on the batter. Das takes his eyes off the ball as he tries to fend, it goes past the gloves and Kyle Verreynne leaps and takes it with one hand.
On off, this is pushed to cover for one.
Some intent needs to be shown here, the run rate is not where Bangladesh would have wanted it to be. This is fuller and on off, Tamim jams it out to the bowler.
On off, Tamim plays it onto the ground.
Byes! Bonus runs! Short and on middle, that takes off. Kyle Verreynne leaps high, he gets a glove to it and it goes behind for two. Byes.
Dealing in singles at the moment! On the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
On the stumps, Iqbal keeps it out nicely.
On off, this is pushed to ocver. Another dot. Runs hard to comeby at the moment.
On off, Iqbal plays it on the off side.
Now takes one as this is worked towards mid-wicket.
Lovely shot but only for one! Fuller and on off, Tamim shows the full face of the bat and strokes it towards mid off. A single taken.
On off, Tamim pushes it to covers.
Maiden from Jansen! Excelllent stuff! Goes for a yorker-length delivery on off. Das digs it out.
A good-length delivery, outside off and angling across Das. Das looks to push it towards the off side but gets beaten off the outside edge.
On a length, on off. Das defends this towards the off side.
Bangs this one short on middle. Das looks to pull it but misses. Good take by the keeper behind the stumps.
Angles this across the batter. On a length and outside off. Das looks to cut it but misses.
Jansen serves this on a length, on middle. Das rides the bounce and defends it towards the leg side.
A single to end the over! On middle, this is clipped through mid-wicket.
Fuller and on off, Das strokes it to covers.
Bowled on middle, Das is solid in defense.
On off, defended.
Angled into the pads,this is worked wide of mid-wicket for one.
On off, this is pushed wide of mid off for one.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over. Change of ends for Rabada. He is back into the attack from the end Lungi Ngidi was bowling.
A good delivery to end! A tidy start then from Jansen! Length and on middle, this lands and moves away. Das looks to defend, it goes more off the outer half to point.
Fuller and on off, Das pushes it to mid off.
Tip and run! On middle, this is played towards wide mid on for one.
Length and on off, Tamim gets right behind the line and blocks.
BEATEN! That does not bounce as much as Tamim expected it too! Shorter and outside off, Tamim looks to cut but is goes under his bat.
Starts off well, on a length and around middle, Iqbal plays it back to the bowler.
Marco Jansen is into the attack now. He replaces Kagiso Rabada.
FOUR! No, he can't! Ngidi is not happy with the point fielder but that was wonderful from Das! He let the ball come to him, stays back and just uses the pace, guides it through point for a boundary.
On middle, blocked. Can Ngidi bowl a maiden?
A little too straight, Das flicks but to mid-wicket.
Good stuff from Ngidi again! Length and on off, Das looks to drop and run on the off side but is sent back.
On middle, Das flicks but to mid-wicket.
On the off pole, Das stays back and guides it to point.
A dot to end! Outside off, not played at.
Slower one outside off, Tamim slashes but misses.
Back of a length and on off, Tamim hangs back and defends. Really good from both the batters, they have looked well in control so far.
Around off, Das arches his back and then guides it past point for one.
Good length and on off, it is kept out.
Good length and on off, it is defended.

FOUR! In the air... but in the gap and a boundary! That has raced away. The outfield here is very quick. On middle, this is clipped uppishly wide of mid-wicket and it races away. The last ball spoils the over somewhat.
Fuller and on off, Tamim pushes it to mid off.
Really good from Ngidi, he has bowled with good control so far. Length again and on off, Tamim looks to drop and run but is sent back.
Angled into middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Angled into the pads, Das works it through square leg and takes one.
Lands it on a length again but just outside off, easy leave.
A dot to end but this is a good start for Bangladesh. On a length and around off, kept out.
Two more! On the pads Tamim works it through mid-wicket for two.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
Misses out! There was width on offer, it was just outside off, it is guided to point.
EDGY FOUR! Looks to stroke this delivery just outside off on the up, it flies off the outside edge past second slip and down to the third man fence.
Back of a length and on off, this is pushed to covers.
On the stumps, this is played back to the bowler. Tidy from Ngidi but nothing on offer for him.
On the stumps, defended.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
On middle, defended.
Tamim now takes one! On off, length, Tamim pushes it between cover and mid off, both look at each other as to who is going for the ball Tamim till then, takes a quick run.
Lovely timing again! Around off, Das plays it late and guides it through point for one.
That is a nasty delivery to end! Shorter again, this time well-directed. On the body, Tamim fends it on the leg side for one.
WIDE! Short one but down the leg side. Left alone.
Just the one! Fuller and on off, this is pushed wide of mid off for one. Tamim will now face Rabada for the first time in this game.
Shot! Once again right off the middle. Length and on off, Das opens the face of the bat and guides it to point.
Length and outside off, easy leave.
Another good stroke! The wicket seems a beauty! Length and on off, Das strokes it on the up through covers for two.
Good length and on off, Das blocks.

SIX! That is over the fence! Tamim is underway in style and the first runs off Ngidi is a biggie, yes it is the shorter side but this is a brilliant shot. Shorter and outside off, Tamim slaps it well over the point fence for a biggie.
Angled into middle, Iqbal pushes it to mid on.
Once again it is a length ball on off, this is pushed to mid off.
Solid! Length and on off, it is blocked.
Length and on off, Iqbal pushes it to covers.
BEATEN! That is a beauty! That is not there to drive though! Length and outside off, Tamim goes after it but is beaten.
Bangs this one short on off. Das pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple. Das and Bangladesh are underway finally!
Pitches this fuller and the ball moves away from the batter. Das looks to drive but gets beaten off the outside edge.
A good-length delivery, outside off. Das leaves it alone.
Angling into body now. This time again some extra bounce. Das just about manages to defend it towards the leg side, little uppishly though.
Ohh...this one takes off! Back of a length, outside off. This one bounce steeply and goes towards the keeper to his right. Das lets it go.
Starts with a back-of-a-length delivery, around off, a bit of extra bounce. Das looks to defend it but the ball hits him high on the bat.
Kagiso Rabada will share the new ball with Lungi Ngidi.
Lands this on a length and outside off. Iqbal lets it go as it seams away with some good bounce. Lungi Ngidi starts with a maiden!
On a length, on middle. Iqbal blocks it soldily.
Fullish delivery on off. Iqbal drives it to mid off.
Beaten this time! A good-length delivery, outside off and seaming away. Iqbal goes for a big booming drive but misses.
On a length, on middle. Iqbal works it towards square leg with the angle.
Ngidi starts with a good-length delivery on off from 'round the wicket. Iqbal blocks this off the front foot.

Time for national anthems! It is Bangladesh's first followed by the South African one. We are done with the anthems now. South African players are in the huddle and they spread out now to take their respective positions. Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das are the openers for Bangladesh. Players from both sides take knee in support of the Black Lives Matter Movement. Lungi Ngidi to start with the ball for South Africa. Here we go...

Mark Boucher, the South African coach, says that it has been a successful season and it is also about how they finish. He mentions that it is an important series for them and they hope to do well. Tells that there is lot of depth in the side and with Nortje and Quinton de Kock missing in the first ODI, it is an opportunity for other guys. He says that it is not ideal to have full-strength side for the Test series but it is what it is.

Russell Domingo, the Bangladesh coach, says that the performance in New Zealand was one of the best he has been part of and that series gives them lot of confidence. He adds that Afghanistan series was a confidence booster too as they have some quality spinners in their lineup. He mentions that having Shakib Al Hasan gives them lot of balance and it is great to have him in the side. Tells that experience plays a big role and it is nice to have that.
Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal (C), Liton Das, Shakib Al Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Yasir Ali, Mahmudullah, Afif Hossain, Mehidy Hasan, Taskin Ahmed, Shoriful Islam, Mustafizur Rahman.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Janneman Malan, Aiden Markram, Temba Bavuma (C), Rassie van der Dussen, Kyle Verreynne (WK), David Miller, Andile Phehlukwayo, Kagiso Rabada, Keshav Maharaj, Marco Jansen, Lungi Ngidi.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of South Africa. They have elected to BOWL first.

Both the sides head into this encounter in form. Bangladesh beat Afghanistan in their own backyard and South Africa recently whitewashed India, they too won at home. Both will want to keep the good work going. However, this is going to be a huge challenge for the visitors who are not such a great visiting side. However, they are an unpredictable team and can surely beat anyone on their day. South Africa on the other hand, will see this as an opportunity to take maximum Super League points and one won't bet against them to do so. Toss and teams in a bit.

With all the Test cricket going on, it is now time to shift focus on the ODI format. It is a three-match ODI series between South Africa and Bangladesh with the first being played in Centurion! Welcome to the coverage.
